"Even the wind, which used to bring cool air, now carries heat," he said, adding he had noticed these drastic changes in the temperature in recent years. However, a closer reading of the records indicates that while Beijing explored limited influence operations, Moscow’s activities were assessed by intelligence officials as broader, more sophisticated and more likely to shape public opinion. The disclosures have reignited a long-running political dispute over foreign election interference, intelligence assessments and how successive administrations have interpreted classified findings. According to the released files, US intelligence agencies identified efforts linked to China to shape public discourse and influence perceptions during the election period. However, analysts repeatedly assessed that Beijing was cautious about taking actions that could destabilise its relationship with Washington or provoke retaliation. By contrast, intelligence assessments described Russia as conducting a sustained campaign using covert online networks, influence operations and disinformation designed to deepen political divisions and undermine confidence

headlines.full_text: Model recruiter for Jeffrey Epstein found dead in France A French professional model recruiter who for over a decade arranged for the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein to meet multiple models, was found dead in his home near Paris on Monday. A French professional model recruiter who for over a decade arranged for the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein to meet multiple models, was found dead in his home near Paris on Monday. Daniel Siad’s body was found in his house in Colombes, a suburb of the French capital, Marie-Céline Lawrysz, deputy public prosecutor at the Nanterre Judicial Court, told CNN in a Wednesday statement. An autopsy will be performed on the body to determine the cause of death. CNN’S Katie Polglase recently interviewed Siad, who said he had no reason to believe two women he had recommended to Epstein – and who had told CNN that Epstein had abused them – had been harmed by him. Even after Epstein’s 2008 conviction on sex crimes, modeling-industry insiders like Siad continued seeking business ventures with him, invited him to fashion events, and allowed him to associate with their companies. Siad said Epstein had assured him he had paid for his crimes and that “this would never happen with anybody” that Siad referred to him. Siad said he had believed Epstein was a casting director for Victoria’s Secret and the modeling agency MC2. CNN found no evidence to support that claim.
